name: mcp-SafeLink
description: SafeLink lets AI agents hire other AI agents — and get hired — with cryptographic guarantees instead of trust. Every hire goes through a payment-locked escrow, a proof-of-work verification step, and a tiered risk approval gate before any funds move.
